fixed.climate: none of its own: an enclosed, over-heated kitchen (geography.json LOC-duchess-kitchen 'hot, smoky, and thick with pepper')

dream_design.flora: bunches of drying herbs and hops hang from the beams in trailing curves; a pot of scarlet geraniums sits on the small window-sill, the one fresh colour in the smoke
dream_design.ornament_cues: pepper-smoke rolls in long ribbon-curls like Mucha hair-lines through the door shaft; the hearth is framed by a tiled surround of poppy-and-vine mosaic, and the copper hood over the fire forms a halo roundel behind the cook (form and material belong to architecture; the cauldron, pans and pepper-box are 1862 props, WR-009)
dream_design.palette: smoky amber, ochre and burnt copper gold under a hazy pastel veil; tile accents in faded teal and rose; the door rectangle is pale gold
dream_design.seasonal_guard: summer herbs and potted geraniums; no evergreen or holly dressing
dream_design.reason: Smoke, fire, cauldron and pepper are explicit (ch006-p19..p20). Dressing, mosaic and palette are designed to WR-010. The smoke haze stays at pepper_smoke density in both states.

fixed.atmosphere: pepper-smoke from the hearth fire and the soup cauldron fills the room end to end; the air is visibly hazy; the heat of the fire adds to the summer heat
fixed.dream_growth: Grows from the family kitchen below stairs, with Dinah on the hearth (index grows_from, cp-cat). The hot summer afternoon Alice is sleeping through becomes, in the dream, a stifling kitchen with the fire lit on a July day. What daylight gets in is the same slanting late-afternoon sun as outside, reduced to a hazy glow through the open door and a small window.

source.quote: The door led right into a large kitchen, which was full of smoke from one end to the other

fixed.reason: Smoke and pepper are explicit (ch006-p19, ch006-p20). The daylight way in and the summer-heat link are designed per ruling 5.2 A; the outside phase is tied to the house-front card so the door view matches.
